fallback_route.purpose: Classify Home route failure or relay the same Home-bound task; do not perform kiosk implementation on the relay node unless Home is unreachable and the result is only a blocked report.

goal: Restore or classify the owner-visible Home kiosk/factory screen from the Home side without running any Mac-local implementation.
objective: On Home, repair the owner-visible Kolibri kiosk or terminal wallboard route. Prefer refreshing an existing tmux/browser/screen session over installing new components. If direct Home execution is unavailable, return the structured blocked route and exact next repair action. Do not print secrets, do not restart production services, and do not change MikroTik or GoMesh routing unless separately owner-approved.
implementation_scope: Confirm hostname/node identity and whether execution is on Home or Home-live.
Inventory existing Home kiosk processes, tmux sessions, display server, browser kiosk command, and Kolibri wallboard paths with secret redaction.
If an existing Home kiosk/tmux session exists, refresh only that session or provide the exact attach/open command.
If no safe local session exists, create a minimal owner-visible Home-side tmux session named kolibri-home-kiosk that shows Control Plane health, active tasks, node freshness, and repair backlog.
If Home is unreachable or lacks display/tmux prerequisites, return a structured blocked response with fallback route evidence and no local relay-node implementation.
acceptance: Execution is proven to be Home/Home-live or the task returns a blocked route report.
No Mac-local implementation, MikroTik route mutation, GoMesh dataplane mutation, secret print, production restart, main push, or force push occurs.
Owner receives an exact attach/open command for the Home kiosk if repaired.
Rollback contains exact commands to stop only sessions/processes created by this task.
Remote artifacts include node, commands, evidence, rollback state, blockers, and next action.

repair_task.action: restore Home Agent Host heartbeat or install/enable missing Home display/tmux prerequisite with owner approval
